d:
In this episode of our Egypt travel series, we explore Day 4 and 5 of our adventure across Southern Egypt!
We begin the day by visiting the colorful and culturally rich Nubian Village in Aswan, where we experience local life, traditions, and incredible hospitality. Then, we hit the road for an unforgettable road trip across Upper Egypt – making stops at the ancient Kom Ombo Temple, the well-preserved Edfu Temple, and finally arriving in Luxor just in time to enjoy a breathtaking sunset over the Nile.
What to Expect in This Video:
Local experience in the Nubian Village, Aswan
